summary: Tested the 3 requested changes (delta cap, 'À traiter' alert navigation, overtime reject button). RESULT: 2 of 3 features are NOT implemented in the codebase. (1) Backend /api/dashboard/executive still returns ca.delta_pct=582.7 and sales.delta_pct=600 — the _delta helper in server.py (line 526) only returns None when prev==0; no 1000€ / 3-sales thresholds and no _delta_count function exists. (2) Alerts navigation works for all three keys (to_schedule→/chantiers, overtime→/heures-sup, commissions→/commissions), verified both via API hrefs and real UI clicks. (3) The overtime reject button does not exist: HeuresSup.jsx HoursCell renders only overtime-validate-<name>-<date>; no overtime-reject testid, no reject handler, no 'Refusé & retiré' toast. Validate still works (cell turns emerald, toast shown). Backend behaviour that reject would rely on (POST /overtime hours=0 deletes the entry) works correctly.

critical.issue: Delta cap NOT implemented. ca.delta_pct=582.7 returned with a tiny previous-month base; sales.delta_pct=600. server.py:526 _delta(cv,pv) returns None only when pv is falsy. Required: return None when prev CA < 1000€, and a separate _delta_count returning None when prev sales count < 3.

ui_bugs.issue: Reject button not implemented. Only the validate button renders on hover for pending+admin cells; no [data-testid^='overtime-reject-'] element anywhere on /heures-sup (count=0 while validate count=1 for a pending cell).
Absurd deltas still visible in UI: '582.7% vs mois préc.' on CA card and '600% vs mois préc.' on Ventes card (frontend Delta guard is fine — it only hides null, backend sends the values).

action_items: server.py dashboard_executive: implement _delta(cv, pv) -> None when pv < 1000 (CA) and add _delta_count(cv, pv) -> None when pv < 3, use it for sales.delta_pct.

HeuresSup.jsx HoursCell: add the red X reject button (data-testid=`overtime-reject-${techName}-${date}`) next to validate for pending entries when isAdmin, calling POST /overtime with hours=0, clearing the cell state and showing toast 'Refusé & retiré'.
No change needed for 'À traiter' alerts — navigation verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:526 — single _delta used for both currency and count metrics; counts need their own low-base guard, otherwise 1→7 sales yields +600%.
Dashboard.jsx line 92 duplicates the Delta rendering logic already in the Stat component (lines 33) — extract to avoid divergence.
/app/backend/server.py is 2283 lines; consider splitting into routers (dashboard, overtime, commissions).
